eps.o: In the wake of a medical emergency, Jackie and Katherine fight to keep the fractured Walters together as they reassess their lives and what matters most.
Jackie struggles to keep up with school commitments as Cole hits a roadblock at the garage. Alex's fame opens the door to an exclusive event.
A high-octane hobby sparks friction at home. While George hits a recovery milestone, Jackie scouts the perfect location for a project close to her heart.
An unexpected visitor arrives for Jackie, sparking a mixed reaction from Cole. Kiley's well-intentioned gesture pushes Alex toward a rowdy crowd.
Cole discovers a bargain in a barn. A surprise reunion at the ranch reopens old wounds. Jackie throws a party for Grace that takes an eventful turn.
With the rumor mill in full swing, tensions flare between Richard and Jackie over her future. Danny and Erin feel the strain of their shared secret.
A troubling exchange with Wylder leaves Alex on edge. An awkward family dinner forces Kiley to face uncomfortable questions about her home life.
Jackie's feverish attempt to regain control pushes her to the brink. Katherine urges Alex to join Cole on a treacherous climb.
While renovating the teen annex, Jackie and her crew uncover a haunting secret frozen in time. George's absence looms over the family scavenger hunt.
As a daunting setback threatens the opening of the community space, Jackie, Cole and Alex reconsider their futures — both romantically and beyond.
